body:
## What it does

Point it at the people engaging with a post - yours or a competitor's - or at a follower list. It browses LinkedIn as you, finds and verifies their work emails through MailAgency, writes each intro individually rather than blasting one template, and sends from your own connected mailbox.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @RealtimeUK shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
